scope: Interactive FreeCAD bilateral review assembly only; not a production Boolean or print source

aggregate_lower_face_mesh_hold.interpretation: Each side is intentionally imported as one aggregate Mesh::Feature containing 60 disconnected closed review solids. The inherited center-seam contact is also retained. FreeCAD's aggregate mesh validator is therefore not used as a production-body gate.
aggregate_lower_face_mesh_hold.independent_evidence: validation-v15.json reports 60 components per side, zero boundary edges and zero non-manifold edges in Blender, and exact X=0 mirrored coordinates for all controlled roles.
aggregate_lower_face_mesh_hold.release_effect: No STL, G-code, production Boolean, or print release is permitted from V15. HS-18 and HS-20 remain open.
